Create bulk dataset from pixel-wise intensity matrix

Source: R/utils_processing.R
preprocessing_create_bulk_exp.Rd

Aggregates pixel-wise intensity matrix to sample-level means and annotates with sample metadata and matched peaks.

Usage

preprocessing_create_bulk_exp(
  intensity.matrix,
  metadata,
  sample.id.column = 4,
  sample.wide.columns = c(),
  organism = "Mouse",
  adducts = c("M-H [1-]", "M-H20-H [1-]", "M+Cl [1-]"),
  ion_mode = "Negative",
  ppm = 5
)

Arguments

intensity.matrix

Data frame of intensities (pixels x features).

metadata

Data frame with pixel metadata (must include sample id and coordinates).

sample.id.column

Name or index of column in metadata table specifying sample of origin.

sample.wide.columns

Names or indices of columns in metadata table with sample-wide information.

organism

Character; organism for pathway filtering ('Human', 'Mouse', 'Rat').

adducts

Character vector of adduct names to use.

ion_mode

Character; ionisation mode.

ppm

Numeric; mass tolerance in ppm.

Value

List with: intensity_matrix (features x samples), metadata (sample-level), matched_peaks (data frame), annotation_table (data frame).
